checks.description: Fixture expected diagnostic count matches the GUI summary.
Displayed rule ID, severity, file, line, and symbol match evidence.
No required text or control is visibly missing.
No obvious overlap, clipping, or off-screen required control is present.
Primary actions remain usable after resize.
Japanese UI has no obvious untranslated, blank, or garbled required text.
English UI has no obvious untranslated, blank, or garbled required text.
Filter state and visible result count are consistent with evidence.
Detail pane matches the selected diagnostic.
Config, export, source-open, and cancel outcomes match the action log.
Before/after state transitions contain no unexplained missing UI state.
